title:
Invalidation queue for cloud queue processing. see the implementations of this
  e.g. {@link EventHubQueue}, {@link KinesisQueue}, {@link KafkaQueue}, {@link SqsQueue}.
This queue is a general purpose queue for all cloud (sqs, kinesis, event hub, ect.) queues in the system. In order
to create a custom cloud queue, do the following:
* Create a type that mixes in {@link CloudInboundMessage} or {@link CloudOutboundMessage}
* If type mixes {@link CloudInboundMessage}, then implement {@link CloudInboundMessage#process}.
name: CloudInvalidationQueue
